criteria.hint: CMHC October survey average of occupied + vacant units; Alberta's own survey for 8 small Alberta towns; a census-based estimate for 4 BC towns with no survey (marked est.). Not today's asking rents.
criteria.label: Rent (2-bed average)

criteria.hint: Vacancy rate, all unit sizes (CMHC, or Alberta's survey): how easy it is to find a place as a newcomer
criteria.label: Rental vacancy

criteria.hint: 2024 median assessed value of single-detached houses in the rural areas around town (StatCan, from BC Assessment / Alberta municipal rolls), weighted by how many of each area's homes you can reach within an hour by road (in BC, no ferries), adjusted to the part of each area within the hour. Assessed values trail sale prices; not listings.
criteria.label: Typical rural house within 1 h (assessed)

criteria.hint: Same, for vacant land parcels. Includes tiny, remote and odd parcels, so it can look very cheap.
criteria.label: Typical vacant rural lot within 1 h (assessed)

criteria.hint: Share of land within 60 km that is forest (NRCan land cover 2020). Not proof of buyable wooded land.
criteria.label: Forest within 60 km

criteria.hint: Non-construction businesses with employees in the town (StatCan business counts)
criteria.label: Commercial market size

criteria.hint: Building + specialty-trade businesses with employees per 100 non-construction businesses. Misses sole operators.
criteria.label: Contractors per 100 client businesses

criteria.hint: Share of homes built before 1981: residential repair & reno work (RJC's secondary market)
criteria.label: Older homes (pre-1981)

criteria.hint: Share of homes needing minor or major repairs, 2021 census (overlaps with older homes)
criteria.label: Homes needing repairs

criteria.hint: Share of residents with 2020 employment income of $80k+ (2021 census). Past earnings, not current vacancies.
criteria.label: Well-paying backup jobs (proxy)

criteria.hint: Hand-set scenario based on the local occupation mix; see the AI switch. Not a forecast.
criteria.label: AI-resistant jobs (scenario)

criteria.hint: Effective number of industries employing locals. Can't see shared dependence on one port, mill or employer.
criteria.label: Economic diversity

criteria.hint: Share of residents aged 25 to 44, 2021 census
criteria.label: People aged 25-44

criteria.hint: Food, drink, arts & recreation businesses per 1,000 people (overlaps with market size)
criteria.label: Restaurants, bars & recreation

criteria.hint: Median single-detached value, 2021 census owner estimate
criteria.label: House prices in town
